caseName: Roemer v. Board of Public Works
caseNameFull: Roemer v. Board of Public Works of Maryland

opinions.text: D. C. Md. Application for an injunction pending appeal presented to The Chief Justice, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Mr. Justice Douglas, Mr. Justice Brennan, and Mr. Justice Marshall would grant the injunction. The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
